confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of New Zealand price levels in Rotorua; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because rates vary with season, event weeks and listing type, and July is winter. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from their local price relationship to beer because direct knowledge is weak: cocktail roughly twice the beer anchor and wine glass roughly 1.25 times it. The FX observation came from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates page and a secondary site showing the same 16 Oct 2026 value. I did not open the RBA page directly, so verify the value against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized New Zealand tourist towns with similar visitor profiles (for example Taupō and Nelson), with Queenstown treated as a higher-cost reference point. Rotorua is generally cheaper than Queenstown for dining and accommodation. Prices are estimated in NZD-level terms and translated to USD by model judgement.
